amendments.change: five Stripe-key-shaped test literals are string concatenations with the same runtime values, as the 2026-11-14 history rewrite left them; the manifest is regenerated so every file verifies
amendments.reason: GitHub push protection rejected the literals; after the rewrite these four files no longer match the v1.1 and v1.2 manifests, so v1.3 supersedes both

amendments.change: the check 'invalid session cookie on create' sends a present but invalid cookie: the cookie names are read once after sign-in, the revoked-session actor gets a copy of the jar, the garbage actor has its own jar with every name set to a value the arm never issued and gets the CSRF token directly, and the check fails when no cookie name was sent; new self-test case A06-unknown-cookie (double mode a06-unknown-cookie-guest) must be reported failed; oracle build 1.3.0, results report pack v1.3; frozen/decisions.md section 11 records it
amendments.reason: A06 gave the revoked-session actor the original jar by reference; an arm that clears the revoked cookie in its 401 emptied it, so the garbage create carried no cookie (cookieNames: []) and the check proved nothing

amendments.change: new fault point clear-route-caches, declared in the adapter's new faultPoints list: the named replica drops every per-process route-cache entry and leaves the shared cache and the database alone; a replica without one does nothing and reports success; F01 runs it on every replica right after injecting each Valkey fault and before that fault's hot redirects, and is blocked with 'adapter has no clear-route-caches fault point' when it is not declared; 'no stampede' passes at most max(2 x redirect replicas, 0.1 x hot requests) database queries per fault; new self-test case F01-inprocess-stampede must be reported failed
amendments.reason: a per-process route cache in each replica served the hot slug through the whole Valkey fault, so the database fallback and the stampede bound were never exercised; v1.3's bound of 2 queries per request grew with the traffic and passed a one-query-per-request fallback

amendments.change: traffic beyond the publisher queue bound: a pack-fixed burst of max(2000, declared queue bound + declared admission bound + 1) concurrent GETs (admissionBound is a new field of inspect publisherQueue; blocked without it); memory growth is measured above a baseline taken with the same number of connections held open and idle, then the GETs are sent on those connections; the limit stays 128 MiB; a 503 without Location passes whether admission or the publisher queue refused it; new self-test case F06-small-bound-unbounded-queue must be reported failed
amendments.reason: the burst was 3 x the arm's own declared bound, so a small declared bound made a small burst and was rewarded, and the measured growth was mostly the cost of accepted sockets

amendments.change: every duration and deadline the oracle measures uses the monotonic clock (performance.now); wall-clock time stays only for recorded timestamps and comparisons with times the arm enforces; new unit test oracle/test/timing.test.ts fakes a 3.6 s wall-clock jump inside measured intervals; oracle build 1.4.0, results report pack v1.4; frozen/decisions.md section 11 records it
